genre_gap.name: endless horror corridor
genre_gap.why: a claustrophobic space that generates forever and is populated with things that want to kill you is a whole category on Roblox, and it fits neither genre it borrows from. Infinite Runner supplies endlessness but assumes automatic forward motion; Survival supplies the threat but both its shapes are bounded, and the one built for being chased explicitly requires loops with zero dead ends - the opposite of a single corridor
